title: Establishing Spontaneous Metastasis in Mice Using a Subcutaneous Tumor Model
author: Liu, Shen, et al.

steps.title: Confirm luciferase and fluorescent expression
steps.instruction: Verify reporter expression in cancer cells before injection.

substeps.instruction: Observe cells under a fluorescence microscope to confirm GFP or RFP expression.
Seed 50,000 cells per well in a 96‑well plate and incubate at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂ for 16 h.
Aspirate all culture medium from each well.
Add 200 µL of medium containing luciferin (150 µg/mL) to each well.
Incubate 5 min at 37 °C.
Measure bioluminescence with an IVIS Lumina II.

steps.title: Culture and expand reporter cell lines
steps.instruction: Grow the luciferase‑GFP/RFP cancer cells in appropriate medium to obtain enough cells for the experiment.

substeps.instruction: Use growth medium supplemented with 10 % fetal bovine serum, 4 mM L‑glutamine, and 1 % penicillin‑streptomycin.
Expand DU145‑RFP‑luciferase cells in a 150 mm petri dish.
Expand NCI‑H82‑GFP‑luciferase cells in a T25 flask (suspension cells are also cultured in T25 flasks).
Ensure the total number of cells matches the planned number of animal injections.

steps.title: Dissociate adherent cells for injection
steps.instruction: Detach adherent cells and collect them in culture medium.

substeps.instruction: Aspirate the culture medium.
Wash cells once with 2 mL 1× PBS.
Aspirate the PBS.
Add 5 mL 0.05 % Trypsin and incubate 5 min in 5 % CO₂ at 37 °C.
Collect the detached cells in a Falcon tube containing 5 mL fresh culture medium.

steps.title: Dissociate suspension cells for injection
steps.instruction: Harvest suspension cells and prepare them for counting.

substeps.instruction: Collect the culture medium and cells in a 15 mL Falcon tube.
Centrifuge at 500 g for 3 min at 20–22 °C; discard supernatant.
Wash once with 2 mL 1× PBS and centrifuge again at 500 g for 3 min at 20–22 °C; discard PBS.
Add 5 mL 0.05 % Trypsin and incubate 5 min in 5 % CO₂ at 37 °C.
Collect the cells in the same tube with 5 mL fresh culture medium.

steps.title: Count viable cells and assess viability
steps.instruction: Determine live cell concentration and ensure viability exceeds 90 %.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge the cell suspension at 500 g for 3 min at 20–22 °C.
Resuspend the pellet in 5 mL culture medium.
Mix 10 µL of cell suspension with 10 µL Trypan blue.
Count cells using a hemocytometer, recording only live cells.
Confirm live‑cell percentage > 90 %; expected yields are ~2 × 10⁷ cells from a 150 mm dish at 90 % confluence and ~3 × 10⁶ cells from a T‑25 flask.

steps.title: Prepare cell‑Matrigel suspension for implantation
steps.instruction: Mix the required number of live cells with cold Matrigel to a final volume of 100 µL per injection.

substeps.instruction: Resuspend exactly 1 × 10⁶ viable cells in a mixture of 80 % Matrigel and culture medium.
Adjust the mixture to a total volume of 100 µL for each tumor implantation.

steps.title: Aliquot and keep cell suspension on ice
steps.instruction: Portion the cell‑Matrigel mixture into individual tubes and maintain it on ice until injection.

substeps.instruction: Aliquot 100 µL (containing 1 × 10⁶ cells in 80 % Matrigel) into a single Eppendorf tube for each mouse.
Keep all tubes on ice and use them within 30 min.
Implant the cells immediately after harvesting; alternatively, Geltrex may be used in place of Matrigel.

steps.title: Prepare injection tools and supplies
steps.instruction: Gather and ready all equipment needed for subcutaneous tumor injection.

substeps.instruction: Autoclave a pair of forceps.
Prepare 29‑gauge insulin syringes for subcutaneous injection.
Place an ethanol pad nearby.
Set out pipettes and appropriate pipette tips.
Check that the anesthesia system is functional.
Have a shaver available for fur removal.

steps.title: Sterilize surgical instruments
steps.instruction: Autoclave the surgical instruments that will be used during the procedure.

substeps.instruction: Autoclave forceps, scissors, and a needle holder.

steps.title: Gather surgical supplies and medications
steps.instruction: Prepare all additional items required for the surgery.

substeps.instruction: Set out a cauterizer, absorbable sutures, and heat pads.
Provide ophthalmic ointment, diet‑gel, Medi‑gel, and Carprofen.

steps.title: Set up sterile surgical work area
steps.instruction: Create a clean, sterile environment for the operation.

substeps.instruction: Spray and wipe the surgical area with 70 % ethanol.
Place a clean surgical pad on the work surface.
Arrange the anesthesia chamber and nosecone, then spray and wipe both with 70 % ethanol.

steps.title: Arrange surgical tools in work area
steps.instruction: Place all sterilized instruments and supplies within the prepared surgical area, maintaining sterility throughout.

steps.title: Quantify metastases using ImageJ
steps.instruction: Analyze metastatic burden after the experiment.

substeps.instruction: Count RFP or GFP fluorescent foci to determine the number of metastases.
Measure the size of each metastatic nodule with ImageJ.
Refer to Liu et al. for an example of the quantification workflow.
